# Two independent agents on one gateway
Run the operator cards in this order: `life-enroll-gateway-host`, `life-add-foreman`, then `life-add-worker` twice with `work_uid=WF-01-A` and `WF-01-B`. The expected config binds both workers to `gw-main` but uses `wkr-wf01-a-p1` and `wkr-wf01-b-p1`.
```text probe = GET /v1/admin/profiles/wkr-wf01-a-p1 probe.agent_state_root = /srv/chd/wkr-wf01-a probe.session_state_root = /srv/chd/wkr-wf01-a/sessions probe = GET /v1/admin/profiles/wkr-wf01-b-p1 probe.agent_state_root = /srv/chd/wkr-wf01-b probe.session_state_root = /srv/chd/wkr-wf01-b/sessions assert profile_a != profile_b assert state_root_a != state_root_b assert session_root_a != session_root_b assert POST /v1/responses(X-Hermes-Profile=wkr-wf01-a-p1).metadata.profile == wkr-wf01-a-p1 assert POST /v1/responses(X-Hermes-Profile=wkr-wf01-b-p1).metadata.profile == wkr-wf01-b-p1 ```
Evidence: query `/chd/registry/wkr-wf01-a`, `/chd/registry/wkr-wf01-b`, both effective config records, and both smoke reports. A worker dispatch names the worker id and profile explicitly; it never inherits the foreman's environment.
